notes: Focused public C++ TCK evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2 p. 380 l. 39-12. Under both HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE, the case calls encode() and decode() on every basic data-element helper class declared by the pinned Table 26 API and asserts that two decoded simple values per helper equal their sources. It also asserts a representative exact-byte vector for each of the 25 helpers, including the MIM-defined HLAboolean values and selected numeric, octet, ASCII, and UTF-16 forms. The HLAunicodeString vector checks a supplementary-character payload and its three-code-unit count. These helper-level checks do not validate the FOM/SOM/MIM basic-representation table fields under §6.2.14 or establish exhaustive Annex C conformance.
